description: This file is a PHP source file for a web interface page that allows users to configure Dynamic DNS settings. It includes server-side PHP code for rendering the page and client-side JavaScript for form validation and dynamic interface interactions. It references external PHP includes for headers, navigation, and footer, and contains inline JavaScript for form validation, AJAX submission, and dynamic UI updates.

methods.name: add1
methods.description: Removes a hostname input field and associated elements from the form upon clicking the remove button.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Dynamically adds a new hostname input field with a remove button to the form when the user clicks 'ADD'.
